senses.gloss:
शृत शृत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्रा), boiled,
(used especially with reference to water, milk, and
ghee); cooked, dressed; [cf. श्राण, श्रपित.]
—शृत-पा, आस्, आस्, अम् (see 2. and 4. पा), Ved. a
drinker or appropriator of an oblation, (Sāy. = क्षी-
रादेर् हविषः पातृ, Ṛg-veda VII. 18, 16.)
—शृत-पाक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a well-
performed cooking, cooked or dressed fit for the
gods, (Sāy. = देव-योग्य-पाकोपेत, Ṛg-veda I.
162, 10.)
शृत, अस्, आ, अम्, boiled, &c. See s. v.
सृत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, proceeded, flowed.
सृत्, त्, त्, त्, going, running, &c.; [cf. स्व-स्˚.]

सृति, इस्, f. a road, path, way; gliding, going,
proceeding; (according to some) hurting, injuring
(perhaps to be connected with rt. सॄ = rt. शॄ).

सृत्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. one who goes or creeps
or moves, (Sāy. = सरण-शील); (आ), m. epithet of
Prajā-pati; = विसर्प; = वृद्धि, (these meanings
are made fem. by Śabda-k.); (अरी), f. a stream,
river; a mother (according to Śabda-k, = माता).

सृत्वर, अस्, ई, अम्, going, moving, creeping,
proceeding, flowing.

सृत्वा, ind. having gone or proceeded, having ap-
proached.
